integrity: The lead arXiv full text was checked at Theorems 3.7 and 3.8 and at its all-k open problem. The 2026 intrinsic-volume paper and the 2021 Besau--Hoehner--Kur paper were checked for their stated k-ranges. The only new proof step is the all-dimensional classical Lower Bound Theorem conversion, followed by monotone substitution into the verified endpoint estimates; the bundled computation checks algebra but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The all-face extension is proved only for simplicial inscribed polytopes and simple circumscribed polytopes. It does not solve the general all-k problem posed in the lead source, and combinatorial sharpness of the face-count conversion does not imply geometric optimality of stacked approximants.
title: All-\(k\) dual-volume bounds for simplicial and simple approximants
